# Sapwood

Sapwood is a browser-based management UI for Heartwood ESP32 signing devices.

## Links

- [Sapwood app](https://sapwood.forgesworn.dev/)
- [About Sapwood](https://sapwood.forgesworn.dev/about/)
- [Web console guide](https://sapwood.forgesworn.dev/about/guide/)
- [Command line guide](https://sapwood.forgesworn.dev/about/cli/)
- [Sapwood source](https://github.com/forgesworn/sapwood)
- [Heartwood firmware](https://github.com/forgesworn/heartwood-esp32)
